raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 2026-01-16 payments-source change renamed status POSTED to SETTLED with unchanged meaning, and batches 12-14 (ingested from 2026-01-17 onward) carry SETTLED. The silver filter `status = 'POSTED'` therefore drops every row from those batches, and the gold tables inherit the gap. Treating SETTLED as the same status as POSTED in the silver filter restores those rows and keeps the output schema unchanged.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED');"}}
